news.title: Jocelyn Benson wants to raise Michigan teacher pay. Union isn’t sold on plan
news.summary_en: The governor-elect wants to raise minimum teacher salaries to $60,000, but one of her biggest allies — the Michigan Education Association — isn’t yet on board. Others are also raising questions.
news.author: Isabel Lohman

news.title: College rates down in Michigan, even with cheap tuition. Can billboards help?
news.summary_en: The battle to increase college graduation rates is going for hearts and minds with a $5 million ad campaign that hopes to combat anti-college narratives.
news.author: Kim Kozlowski

news.title: Report: Funding, opportunity gaps hurting educational progress in Michigan
news.summary_en: At an event in Detroit Tuesday morning, EdTrust-Midwest shared many concerning metrics about Michigan schools. Leaders say the state must invest deeply into districts with high concentrations of poverty and lean into literacy reforms to see change.
news.author: Isabel Lohman

news.title: Parents of Michigan students with disabilities demand special education reforms
news.summary_en: More than 75 people attended a meeting Monday night focused on what the state can do to improve special education. Many shared personal stories of their students.
news.author: Isabel Lohman
